entities.name: Istfell
entities.description: A mist-shrouded realm of Kaldheim at the base of the World Tree where the spirits of most of the dead go.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane of ten realms that includes Istfell.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: The vast tree whose roots plunge into Istfell.

entities.name: Gods' Hall
entities.description: The building housing the gods, the only structure in Istfell besides the wall and the gate.

entities.name: Vangir River
entities.description: The bone-chilling river encircling the plains of Istfell.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: The realm where the Valkyries take those who die bravely or gloriously.

entities.name: Valkyries
entities.description: Beings who mark brave dead and take them to Starnheim.

relations.note: One of the ten realms of Kaldheim.
relations.quote: Istfell is one of the ten realms of the plane of Kaldheim .

relations.note: They take the gloriously dead there.
relations.quote: People who die in particularly brave or glorious fashion are marked by the Valkyries and taken to Starnheim .
